text:
rachel_pm: Quick thread for Helix consortium POC — they want a clear onboarding checklist, pricing buckets per reseller-customer, and answers for the security questionnaire by next Wed. Can we map owners?
ola_partner: Helix wants per-tenant SAML + option to use their brokered SSO in front. Also asked about per-tenant audit log access.
tom_sales: Pricing ask: two options — (A) per-tenant reserved vGPU slices billed monthly, (B) pooled shared capacity with per-tenant usage metering. Need simple $/month examples for a 5-customer pilot.
vikas_sec: Security: SAML metadata exchange ok. Need to confirm whether Helix will assert role mappings or we map on our side. Also need to know data residency for logging and whether any pilot customers require HIPAA.
nina_devex: We can support both SSO patterns. For SAML brokered flow the provisioning looks like: ```POST /v1/tenants {"name":"helix-cust-1","provisioning":{"sso":"saml","saml_metadata":"<xml>...</xml>"}}``` demo-ready.
ola_partner: They prefer brokered SSO for onboarding speed. Audit logs: Helix ops wants read-only logs for their customers for troubleshooting, but legal wants redaction.
vikas_sec: Redaction + role-based access is fine. We'll offer tenant-scoped log views with PII masking. For HIPAA scope: two customers are in healthcare; assume HIPAA controls needed.
tom_sales: For pricing examples, can we model a baseline 3 vGPU equivalent per customer reserved -> $7k/mo each. Shared pool for 5-customer pilot baseline 6 vGPU pool -> $26k/mo total (~$5.2k/customer) plus egress. Numbers are illustrative.
rachel_pm: Tom — can you add a 95th/99th percentile token estimate for billing? Helix asked for cost sensitivity at peak.
tom_sales: Will produce a small spreadsheet and assumptions. Sending EOD.
nina_devex: Infra note: for brokered SSO we need a service account for Helix with tenant_admin scope. Also recommend using short-lived tokens for CLI provisioning.
vikas_sec: KMS/Encryption: for the pilot recommend per-tenant CMKs (recommended) or a customer-managed key for Helix (if they insist). For HIPAA tenants we require HSM-backed keys and separate retention.
ola_partner: Helix legal also submitted a security questionnaire PDF. I uploaded to the shared drive and left notes on pages 4-6 re: incident response and log retention.
rachel_pm: Blockers: (1) Confirm KMS approach for HIPAA tenants (vikas), (2) produce pricing sheet (tom), (3) demo script for brokered SSO + provisioning (nina). Owners assigned.
infra-bot: ticket#54012 created: "Helix POC - Dedicated pool & SSO service account" (owner: nina_devex) ETA 6 business days.
vikas_sec: I'll draft the security appendix to attach to the SOW covering log redaction, KMS options, and incident notification SLAs. Target Tue.
nina_devex: I'll prep a 10-min demo showing tenant provisioning via CLI + console and the SAML exchange. Need Helix test IdP metadata by Fri.
tom_sales: Pricing spreadsheet uploaded to drive: link https://drive.redwood.com/helix/pilot-pricing. Feedback welcome.
rachel_pm: Great. Let's do a 30m check-in Monday 9:30am PT to run through demo and finalize pricing. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
